record.one_liner: Cloud web-based help desk and shared inbox for support teams, with AI agents and a built-in MCP server
record.auth_notes: Public API v3 and legacy v1 each use a separate API key, created under Configuration > System > API (v3) or the API v1 settings section. The MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 for AI clients, but that is not the public REST API auth path.
record.access_notes: The fetched pages show plans from $15 per agent per month and no free plan. A 30-day free trial was seen only in search snippets (migration and customer-experience pages) and was not opened with fetch_page, so treat trial access as medium confidence.
record.api_notes: Two API versions: v1 is deprecated but functional and v3 is current and actively developed. Endpoint-level breadth was not verified on a fetched API reference page.
record.blocker_notes: Credentials are self-serve and the API is documented. Paid plans are needed after any trial, and this is not a blocker for building. The trial length was not confirmed on a fetched page.
